title: Skill Pack Manifest (manifest.yaml)
description: Portable spec for an agent package that runs on IAF AgentOS, Claude Cowork / Claude Code, Anthropic Managed Agents, or any compatible harness. A skill pack is a single folder containing this manifest plus a SKILL.md and optional context/hooks/tools/viewers.

spec_version.description: Pack spec version this manifest conforms to. Currently fixed at 1.0.

name.description: Package identifier. Lower-case snake_case. Must match the folder name.

description.description: One-paragraph summary used by catalogs, marketplaces, and router prompts.

agent_type.description: Execution mode expected by this pack. Maps directly to IAF AgentOS execution_mode. Other harnesses translate per the mapping table in SKILL_PACK_SPEC.md.

recommended_model.description: Model recommendations. Hosts resolve provider+tier to a concrete model. Use {provider: any} to let the host pick.

requires.description: Capabilities this pack needs from the host. Host MUST reject installation if any required capability is unsupported.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hook points the pack registers handlers at.

ui.description: Whether HTML viewers are required, optional, or absent.

network.description: Outbound network capabilities. Host's entitlement layer enforces these.

mcp_servers.description: MCP server names the pack expects available (e.g. servicenow, gmail, jira).

min_harness_version.description: Lower bound on harness version. Host rejects install if older.

callable_agents.description: Sub-agent / worker skill packs this pack invokes. Use NAME or NAME>=VERSION syntax.

inputs.description: Variables the deployer must set at install time. Hosts surface these in their install UI.

outputs.description: Structured outputs the pack produces. Used by UI viewers and for chaining packs.

format.description: MIME or format hint (pdf, csv, png, ...)

viewers.description: HTML viewers shipped with the pack. Hosts that render UI may load these inline (postMessage contract) or standalone.

file.description: Path relative to pack root, e.g. viewers/result_card.html

renders_output.description: Name of an output (from outputs[]) this viewer can render.

tests.description: Portable smoke tests. Hosts that support automated validation run these.

expects.description: Substrings that MUST appear in the final response.

compatibility.description: Optional per-host adaptation hints. Used by host shims when translating this pack into native form.

max_context_tokens.description: Minimum context window the model must support.
